[[The Lab]] |chapter = |traders =[[BTR Driver]] |enemies =[[Scavs]], [[Kaban]], [[Kollontay]] |players =12-16 |difficulty = |duration =40 minutes |notable loot = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Map of Tarkov|location]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. It is the ninth map that was added to the game. ==Description== Downtown Tarkov houses banks, malls, and hotels, as well as all the other amenities a thriving metropolis could have needed. ==Notes== {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. ==Features== * Stationary weapons in the form of [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher]]s and [[NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine gun]]s. * Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]] and [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]]! ==Usable Keys==
